status: All three native ARM signed runtime/SDK installations pass with no warnings or errors in their qualification logs. Publication remains disabled.

root_causes.signature_notices: The old prepublication runner verified hashes but explicitly bypassed package signatures and did not import the OBS key.
root_causes.llvm_manual_notices: Leap container zypp.conf excludes documentation by default; LLVM post-install alternatives refer to those files.

fixes: Pin the public OBS key by SHA-256 before mutation, import it, verify each RPM signature, and retain normal package-manager GPG checks.
Reject unsigned RPMs even when rpmkeys reports valid digests. Support tested RPM 4 and RPM 6 output formats.
Copy zypp.conf into the temporary fixture directory and set rpm.install.excludedocs=no; retain all other distribution settings.

tests.signature_controls: Trusted, unsigned, corrupt and untrusted-key RPM controls pass on all three distributions.
tests.leap_documentation: Fresh Leap installation: 92 LLVM manual files present, rpm -V clean, no diagnostics.
